source: Pentaho-like screen: Data Catalog dataset list
title: Data Catalog datasets list
prompt:
Ticket: Datasets list in the Data Catalog

Add a page at /catalog where data stewards browse and clean up the catalog's datasets. Use the datasets API in src/api/datasets.ts.

- Show each dataset's name, owner, domain, certification status, data quality and when it was last updated.
- Users can search by name, filter by certification status, and page through the results, 10 at a time.
- From each row users can open the dataset (go to /catalog/<id>; that page is out of scope) or delete it.
- Users can select several datasets and delete them in one go.
- The page offers a "Register dataset" action (for now it only logs to the console).

The design mock is in mock.png in the project root.
